response.sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), product_shares AS (SELECT product_type_description, avg_quantity, item_count, 1.0 * item_count / SUM(item_count) OVER () AS item_share FROM product_stats), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_share FROM product_shares GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS average_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS average_share FROM type_stats

assumptions.assumption: Quantities are numeric text; NULL, empty, and whitespace-only quantities are missing.
